QuestInfo.name: Peace at Eos Tower
QuestInfo.1: You were asked to defeat the Lord Block Golem, #rRombot#k, so that Eos Tower can finally be repaired. \r\n\r\nTip: Rombot is sometimes seen beyond the hidden portal at #b#m221020300##k...
QuestInfo.2: You defeated Lord Block Golem Rombot. That'll help keep Eos Tower standing for a while.

0.0: Big problem! Very serious! Eos Tower needs repairs, but we've got trouble.

yes.0: Great! My repair work was interrupted by this huge, HUGE thing. It was super scary. I feel like it must be the boss of the monsters around here.
yes.1: I've hear that once in a while, #rRombot#k appears past the Hidden Portal on #b#m221020300##k. He's got to go!
yes.2: I've hear that once in a while, #rRombot#k appears past the Hidden Portal on #b#m221020300##k. Eliminate Rombot!

no.0: Seriously? Do I look like the kind of guy that can handle big problems by himself? I'm poly enough to admit I need help!

1.0: Wow, you really defeated #b#o4130103##k? I was starting to worry I'd sent you to your doom, but here we are!

yes.0: Phew! With that out of the way, I can get back to my tower maintenance. Thanks again!

mob.0: You still have not completed my request. Go through the Hidden Portal on #b#m221020300##k to defeat the Leader of the Block Golems, #r#o4130103##k, who appears occasionally. Bring friends!
